{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Inventory

|descr= Save unit's loadout.

|s1= [unit, input, params, delete] call [[BIS_fnc_saveInventory]]

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - unit whose inventory should be saved

|p2= input: [[Array]] format [target, loadoutName]:
* target: [[Namespace]], [[Group]] or [[Object]] - target where the loadout is stored
* loadoutName: [[String]] - loadout name

|p3= params: [[Array]] - (Optional, default []) custom parameters stored with the loadout

|p4= delete: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) whether or not to delete the loadout

|r1= [[Array]] - saved value

|x1= <sqf>[player, [missionNamespace, "BIS_inv"], [], true] call BIS_fnc_saveInventory;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_loadInventory]][[BIS_fnc_exportInventory]][[BIS_fnc_deleteInventory]] [[getUnitLoadout]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Ilias38rus
|timestamp= 20200802152200
|text= Doesn't work for backpacks in backpack, unlike [[getUnitLoadout]].
}}
